Amelia H.: quick RFC follow-up: propose a light edge adapter to translate v1 client requests to the new v2 shape. goals: low CPU, preserve streaming, minimal SDK churn.

Jordy: what transformations? header-only or JSON rewrites? latency impact? :eyes:

Amelia H.: header sniff + small rewrites: rename fields, wrap single `prompt` into `input_prompts` array, convert v1 batch into one streaming frame. estimated p95 +2-6ms.

Devon: infra note: run adapter before upstream pool selection to keep keepalives. gate with `EDGE_COMPAT_LIGHT_ADAPTER`.

Sara (SDK): SDK should opt-in release that sets `X-Compat-Client` header so rewrites are explicit. add telemetry `compat=light-adapter`.

mike-sre: error/fallback policy? instrument `adapter.mapping_errors`. prefer fail-fast 400 for mapping issues; 503 for internal adapter faults with `Retry-After`.

Amelia H.: streaming: translate frames live where possible; only buffer if necessary. add metric `adapter.fallback_to_buffered`. circuit-breaker: if fallback rate >0.5% in 5m, throttle adapter flows.

Devon: perf safeguard: if adapter adds >100ms per-frame, switch to buffered path and count fallback. alert if p95 latency bump >10ms for 15m and auto-disable route.

Sara (SDK): rollout sketch: announce + guide; opt-in SDK release; 1% tenants via feature-flag; ramp by metrics; deprecation header at week 5.

ops-bot: deploy queued: edge/adapters/light-adapter v0.1 -> staging (sha:7a3f9e).

Amelia H.: owners: Amelia (design), Devon (infra/load), Sara (SDK/docs), Mike (SRE/runbooks). I'll post an RFC addendum with mappings and sample curl for support. Targeting 1% flip next Wed.
